title: Product Lead & Product Owner
text: **Job Overview** **Digital products and technical delivery \| 5 to 8 years** This role turns business problems into prioritised, testable product work and owns the path from discovery through release. The product lead should make clear decisions, resolve data and scope questions and coordinate stakeholders throughout delivery. **Must Have Skills** • Proven experience translating business problems into clear product requirements, user stories and measurable outcomes. • Strong backlog ownership, including prioritisation, dependency management and maintaining delivery-ready work. • Ability to write clear acceptance criteria and establish a practical definition of done. • Experience creating product roadmaps, release plans and phased delivery strategies. • Ability to understand data models, REST API specifications and system workflows well enough to identify gaps and assumptions. • Ownership of open data questions, including identifying dynamic data, missing fields and required decisions. • Strong UX judgement and the ability to give precise, actionable feedback on designs and working software. • Ability to balance customer value, user experience, engineering effort, risk and delivery timelines. • Strong stakeholder-management experience across business, sales, support, engineering, design and external partners. • Experience planning and leading user acceptance testing, managing defect triage and securing business sign-off. • Experience planning product rollouts, migrations and release communications. • Ability to define success measures, track adoption and use evidence to guide prioritisation. • Strong facilitation, decision-making and written communication skills. • Demonstrated ability to learn technical and industry domains quickly. • Practical experience with Jira, Confluence and wireframing or prototyping tools. **Good to Have Skills** • Experience owning technically complex, data-heavy or graphics-intensive products. • Experience with mapping, geospatial, 3D, visualisation or product-configuration solutions. • Familiarity with front-end architecture, API integration and software delivery processes. • Experience with analytics platforms and product-adoption dashboards. • Knowledge of experimentation, A/B testing and hypothesis-driven discovery. • Experience working with external API providers, technology partners or enterprise clients. • Familiarity with accessibility, privacy, security and relevant regulatory requirements. • Experience running interviews, workshops, prototype reviews and usability testing. • Experience coordinating Agile delivery across multiple teams. • Experience supporting go-to-market planning, customer onboarding or product enablement.

title: Product Owner, Digital Financing & Wealth, Digital Banking
text: **Lead. Innovate. Transform.** Drive the future of Digital Financing and Wealth at Maybank Singapore by designing customer-centric digital journeys and experiences that enhance customer engagement, accelerate adoption, and deliver sustainable business growth and impact. You will own the customer journey end-to-end, drive measurable business outcomes, and work closely with Business, Technology, Operations, Risk and Compliance teams to deliver secure, scalable and customer-centric digital banking solutions. You will have influence over what gets built and why, across two of the bank's key growth areas. This role will also collaborate and support complementary strategic digital initiatives and ecosystem partnerships as part of future-proofing capabilities. Responsibilities:- **Product Strategy \& Ownership** * Define the product vision, roadmap and priorities for Digital Financing and Wealth journeys, aligned to business objectives and customer needs. * Develop and present product proposals, business cases and impact assessments to senior stakeholders. * Establish success metrics such as adoption, conversion and digital sales, and use data-driven insights to continuously optimise business outcomes. **Digital Financing \& Wealth Transformation** * Drive digital financing journeys for secured lending products, with exposure to unsecured lending considered an advantage. * Lead digital investment journeys across products such as unit trusts, bonds, equities and structured products. * Apply customer research, journey mapping and design thinking methodologies to create intuitive and engaging digital experiences. **Agile Product Delivery** * Lead Agile delivery from ideation through implementation, including user story definition, backlog management, UAT, production rollout and business adoption. * Partner with Business, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance and external vendors to deliver scalable, resilient and secure solutions within scope, budget and timeline. * Anticipate dependencies, manage delivery risks and ensure regulatory and security requirements are embedded early in the product lifecycle. **Business Adoption \& Continuous Improvement** * Drive change readiness, training and rollout activities to ensure successful adoption across business and operations teams. * Own production incidents, root cause analysis and backlog prioritisation for service improvements. * Collaborate with analytics and customer experience teams to identify opportunities for optimisation and continuous enhancement. * Support complementary strategic digital initiatives and ecosystem partnerships that strengthen customer value propositions and future capabilities. Requirements: * A good degree with at least 8 years' relevant experience in Banking, Digital Banking, Lending and/or Wealth Management. * Proven experience as a Product Owner leading complex digital transformation initiatives. * Demonstrated track record of launching digital journeys and driving measurable improvements in customer adoption, conversion and digital sales. * Strong knowledge of secured lending products and customer journeys, including credit assessment, eligibility, approval and fulfilment processes. * Good understanding of investment products, including unit trusts, bonds, equities and structured products, and their associated digital journeys from discovery and suitability assessment to transaction execution and portfolio servicing. * Familiarity with MAS regulatory requirements, scam and fraud prevention controls, and data privacy obligations. * Strong stakeholder management, influencing, analytical and problem-solving skills. * Ability to drive outcomes independently while leading cross-functional teams and managing competing priorities. * Experience working in Agile environments and managing delivery across multiple internal teams and external vendors. * Experience in unsecured lending products and journeys. * Experience with core banking or wealth management platforms such as Avaloq. * Understanding of emerging technologies and innovations, including AI and advanced analytics within financial services. Only shortlisted candidate will be notified.

title: SVP, Lead Technical Product Owner (Corporate/Data Domain)
text: Job description Product Analysis and Shaping Develop a deep understanding of the products in your domain (e.g., features, user experience, technical architecture, data flows) and contribute to the long-term technology roadmap of the product domain. Define, with the Business Owner and your team, the north-star metric and supporting KPIs that guide product iteration, and partner with engineering and data teams to ensure these metrics are observable. Produce the artefacts that engineering or vendors needs to act on, whether that's requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria or AI-assisted product specs, by partnering with stakeholders to understand the underlying business opportunities. Roadmap and Prioritisation Co-own the product roadmap with the Business Owner, keeping it aligned with company goals, member needs, regulatory context, and other products within your domain and across domains. Prioritise features and enhancements based on evidence of user impact, business value, regulatory requirements and technical feasibility. Work with software vendors to shape their roadmap support SGX's ambitions. Stakeholder Management Communicate product direction, metrics, and progress to internal and external stakeholders at all levels. Build consensus and manage expectations around priorities, trade-offs, and the inherent uncertainty in product work. Support your team in complex stakeholder settings. Ways of Working Use AI agentically to accelerate discovery, prototyping, and specification (e.g., generate working mockups, draft technical specs, validate assumptions) before engineering invests time. Drive continuous discovery through member interviews, prototypes as tests, and usage data analysis. Make trade-offs explicit (scope vs. timeline, build vs. buy, quick win vs. durable fix) and drive decisions around them. Challenge the status quo and help shape the product practice and SDLC improvements as they evolve across the engineering and product organisation. Leadership Create, lead, and manage a high-performing and efficient team of Technical Product Owners and UX Designers. Elevate the team's productivity by instilling a deep understanding of the market, customer demands and platform capabilities. Develop and execute the strategic vision for SGX's products within your domain and share this with the team, keep them excited and highly engaged. Ensure the team's awareness of the importance of ensuring resiliency and stability for SGX's systems, especially CIIs. Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. #J-18808-Ljbffr

cases of deployment. * Strong understanding of the Private Bank and/or Wealth management landscape in terms of products, functional teams, services, and typical banking applications. * Strong understanding of design thinking/ human centered design methodology and experience in using it in project implementation. * Experience in customer immersions, journey mapping and design. * Strong analytical, problem solving, communication and creative skills. **Additional Requirements** Be a Part of the UOB Family UOB is an equal opportunity employer. title: Product Manager - DS/MC
text: **About ST Engineering** **ST Engineering**is a global technology, defence, and engineering group with offices across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and the U.S., serving customers in more than 100 countries. The Group uses technology and innovation to solve real-world problems and improve lives through its diverse portfolio of businesses across the aerospace, smart city, defence, and public security segments. Headquartered in Singapore, ST Engineering ranks among the largest companies listed on the Singapore Exchange. Our history spans more than 50 years, and our strategy is underpinned by our core values -- Integrity, Value Creation, Courage, Commitment and Compassion. These 5 core values guide every aspect of our business and are embedded in our ST Engineering culture -- from the people we hire, to working with each other, to our partners and customers. **About our Line of Business -- Mission Software \& Services** Our **Mission Software \& Services**business provides leading-edge mission critical command, control, and communications (C3) systems with secured IT infrastructure and managed services. We support our client's innovation journey through design thinking, analytics, and AI-enabled decision support with our full suite of cloud computing solutions. We provide intelligent, actionable insights and sustainable solutions to our valued partners in diverse industries including defence, government, and commercial sectors. **Together We Can Make A Significant Impact** You will lead end-to-end product delivery, from discovery through launch and measurement, while coaching client Product Managers to build lasting capability. This is a consultancy role: you own outcomes, not just outputs, and you bring the same rigour to enabling others as you do to shipping products. **Be Part of Our Success** * Identify riskiest assumptions and design validation initiatives; define OKRs and outcome-based roadmaps. * Plan and run user research (interviews, usability tests) that validate or kill hypotheses before build. * Define Product strategy, Story Mapping and writing user stories with clear acceptance criteria, facilitate backlog refinement and sprint planning * Track delivery KPIs (velocity, cycle time), manage dependencies and mitigate risks proactively * Define go-to-market strategies, measurement frameworks, and analytics instrumentation * Analyse post-launch data and drive iterative improvements, facilitate retrospectives * Coach client Product Managers through daily pairing, identify gaps and tailor enablement. * Create psychologically safe environments for learning and collaboration * Facilitate workshops, demos, and stakeholder alignment; navigate complex organizational dynamics **Qualities We Value** * Experience: 5 years across the full product lifecycle, shipping end-to-end; track record of leading discovery and killing projects when evidence demands it. * Methods: Lean Startup, Continuous Discovery, OKRs, JTBD, Impact Mapping, outcome-based roadmaps. * Mindset: Empathy, end-to-end ownership; intellectual humility to pivot; energised by enabling others as much as delivering yourself. * Bonus: Familiarity with SG Gov ecosystem (SHIP-HATS, SG Tech Stack, GeBIZ) or prior experience with Singapore Government agencies. * Coaching: Experience enabling Product Managers or Owners through pairing or mentorship in a consultancy or client-facing context. **Our Commitment That Goes Beyond the Norm** * An environment where you will be working on cutting-edge technologies and architectures. * Safe space where diverse perspectives are valued, and everyone's unique contributions are celebrated. * Meaningful work and projects that make a difference in people's lives. * A fun, passionate and collaborative workplace. * Competitive remuneration and comprehensive benefits.

title: Product Manager
text: Product Manager =============== **Application Deadline:** 1 December 2026 **Department:**Product **Employment Type:**Full Time **Location:**Singapore ### Description 🚢 Discover OneOcean: OneOcean is a unified brand born from the integration of OneOcean and Ocean Technologies Group. Owned by Lloyd's Register, an organisation with more than 260 years of trust, integrity and leadership at sea, OneOcean combines the agility and ambition of a fast-moving innovator with the strength and stability of one of the world's most trusted maritime institutions. At the heart of OneOcean is a portfolio unlike any other in maritime. A comprehensive, integrated portfolio built on years of expertise, trusted by thousands of maritime professionals around the world. 🎯 Our Mission: Our mission is clear. In the race to zero emissions, our research, advisory and technical expertise and industry-firsts are supporting a safe, sustainable maritime energy transition. Today we are a leading provider of classification and compliance services to the marine and offshore industries, helping our clients design, construct and operate their assets to accepted levels of safety and environmental compliance. 🔍 Why Join OneOcean Crew? Legacy \& Innovation: We were created more than 260 years ago as the world's first marine classification society to improve and set standards for the safety of ships. Global Impact: Our digital solutions are relied upon by more than 30,000 vessels, following the acquisition of OneOcean in 2022 and Ocean Technologies Group in 2024. Product Offering: Covering five proven product areas - learning, fleet operations, compliance, voyage planning and performance management - supporting its customers from ship to shore, from training and people operations, to voyage compliance and optimisation. 🧭 **Navigating the position: Product Manager** We are seeking an experienced **Senior Product Owner** with a maritime industry background and extensive knowledge of the **TM Master product.** This role is critical to ensuring that the TM Master product evolves in line with the complex operational needs of modern shipping companies. You will take responsibility for key TM Master Modules and act as the bridge between stakeholders, customers, and engineering teams---owning the product backlog for those modules. Working with the Senior Product Manager, you will collaborate in shaping product strategy, defining priorities, and delivering high-impact features that improve operational efficiency, compliance, safety and vessel performance. We are looking for someone who is genuinely curious about the problems maritime operators face, rigorous about how they make decisions, and comfortable working with ambiguity ### Key Responsibilities **Product Ownership \& Delivery** * Own and manage the **TM Master product backlog**, ensuring clear prioritisation aligned with business goals * Translate product strategy into actionable user stories and acceptance criteria * Work closely with engineering teams in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver high-quality releases * Drive sprint planning, backlog grooming, and review sessions **Customer \& Stakeholder Engagement** * Collaborate with maritime customers (ship managers, superintendents, crew) to gather insights and validate requirements * Act as the voice of the customer, ensuring solutions address real operational challenges onboard and ashore * Align with internal stakeholders including Sales, Support, and Implementation teams **Product Strategy \& Roadmap** * Contribute to and execute the product roadmap for TM Master * Identify opportunities for innovation in maintenance, compliance, procurement, and vessel performance * Balance short-term delivery with long-term product vision **Domain Expertise \& Compliance** * Leverage knowledge of maritime operations (planned maintenance systems, safety, compliance) * Ensure product alignment with industry regulations (e.g., ISM, class requirements, audits) * Stay informed on trends in digital shipping, IoT, and fleet optimisation **Data \& Continuous Improvement** * Define and track product KPIs (adoption, performance, customer satisfaction) * Use data and user feedback to iterate and improve features * Champion continuous improvement and product excellence ### Skills, Knowledge and Expertise **Product Ownership \& Delivery** * 5 years experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager in a B2B environment * Strong track record of working in Agile/Scrum teams and delivering complex software products at scale * Proven ability to manage and prioritise large, complex backlogs **Maritime Domain Expertise** * Solid experience within the **maritime industry** * Extensive knowledge of **Planned Maintenance Systems (PMS)** and associated operational workflows, in particular TM Master. * Strong understanding of vessel operations, compliance, and maintenance practices **TM Master / Product Knowledge** * Extensive hands-on knowledge of the **TMv2 product** and its modules, data structures, and workflows * Ability to translate real-world maritime use cases into product requirements and improvements **Technical \& Analytical Skills** * Competent in using **SQL Manager** and writing queries for data analysis and validation * Comfortable working with data to support product decisions and troubleshoot issues **Stakeholder Communication** * Strong ability to **present user workflows, concepts, and solutions** clearly to stakeholders and customers * Excellent communication skills with the ability to bridge technical and non-technical audiences **Preferred Experience (Highly Desirable)** * Experience in the **maritime industry**, particularly with: TM Master Planned Maintenance Systems (PMS), Fleet management software, Shipboard/offshore operations * Familiarity with maritime PMS system integrations with ERP, freight, CBM and ecommerce platforms * Understanding of vessel operations, dry docking, and compliance workflows

title: Lead Product Manager, Physical AI
text: Company Description - ------------------ **About Grab and Our Workplace** Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility. Job Description - -------------- **GET TO KNOW THE TEAM** Grab's Geo and IoT team builds the location capabilities behind our services. Our Physical AI initiative is building a platform for embodied and egocentric AI training data across Southeast Asia, connecting labs that need high-quality data with people who collect it in the field. **GET TO KNOW THE ROLE** You will own this platform from pilot to scale. As a senior individual contributor, you will shape the product and business strategy, build a trusted collector experience, and turn partner requirements into reliable, compliant data delivery. You will work closely with Operations, Partnerships, Engineering, Data Science, Legal, and Data Privacy, including teams on the ground across the region. This role is based onsite in Singapore. **THE CRITICAL TASKS YOU WILL PERFORM** * Set the platform strategy across lab demand, field collection, and data curation; define partner priorities, build-versus-partner choices, pricing, incentives, and unit economics. * Work with AI labs and Partnerships to translate training needs into dataset specifications, quality criteria, delivery timelines, and service commitments. * Own the collector experience, including field tooling, clear instructions, incentives, and reliable payments to ensure supply is productive and sustainable. * Prioritize the platform for collection, annotation, labeling, quality assurance, and delivery. Partner with Engineering and Data Science to turn model feedback into improved data and workflows; leverage AI tools where they enhance research and execution. * Build a roadmap with clear milestones and trade-offs. Work with Operations and country teams to assess field readiness, visit sites, resolve risks early, and scale successful pilots. * Partner with Legal, Data Privacy, Procurement, and country stakeholders to address consent, site and vendor terms, data handling, and cross-border delivery prior to scaling collection. Qualifications - ------------- **WHAT ESSENTIAL SKILLS YOU WILL NEED** * At least 4 years of experience in product management or equivalent impact, with ownership of a significant product from ambiguous opportunity through launch and iteration. * Experience shipping an AI-native product where AI is central to the value proposition, alongside fluency in training data, evaluation, and feedback loops. * Experience building a multi-sided platform that connects customer demand, field operations, data quality, and end-user experience. * Commercial judgment in partner prioritization, pricing, incentives, and unit economics, with the ability to turn strategy into actionable product decisions. * Ability to write clear product requirements and evaluate trade-offs across technical, operational, quality, cost, and time constraints. * Experience working across Engineering, Data Science, commercial, and operations teams, including privacy and legal specialists, to deliver a product responsibly. **GOOD TO HAVE** * Experience in embodied AI, robotics, world models, egocentric or geospatial data, or sensor-based collection. * Experience with AI-lab partnerships, annotation workflows, or large-scale multi-country field operations. Additional Information - --------------------- **Life at Grab** We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer: * We have your back with **Term Life Insurance** and comprehensive **Medical Insurance.** * With **GrabFlex,**create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations. * Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through **Parental** and **Birthday leave** , and give back to your communities through **Love-all-Serve-all (LASA)** volunteering leave * We have a confidential **Grabber Assistance Programme** to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges. * Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours **What We Stand For at Grab** We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Senior Product Manager
text: Razorpay is one of India's leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we've since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India's digital payment revolution. Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow. From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech. title: Product Manager / Director, VIP Growth & Operations Singapore, Singapore
outNote: VIP client growth operations, lifecycle programmes and events
text: Job description Product Manager / Director, VIP Growth \& OperationsOKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa. Who We AreAt OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. About The OpportunityOKX is seeking an experienced VIP Growth \& Operations Leader to focus on creating exclusive product experiences and service solutions for high-net-worth individuals, institutional clients, market makers, and other VIP customer segments. You will spearhead the overall strategy and product planning for the VIP Growth \& Operations line, driving customer lifecycle management, personalized services, and continuous optimization of system functionalities to enhance customer retention and platform AUM (Assets Under Management). What You'll Be DoingOwn the day-to-day VIP Growth \& Operations execution for high-net-worth individual clients, ensuring VIP lifecycle programs are planned, launched, and iterated effectively. Build and run a VIP lifecycle operations framework : define segments, triggers, and journeys; set weekly/monthly operating rhythms; and ensure consistent execution with Local Markets. Partner with Local Market teams to co-create market plans, align goals and timelines, and drive follow-through, while ensuring global consistency and scalable playbooks. Plan and execute VIP offsites and online events (e.g., product sharing sessions, community/engagement touchpoints), including end-to-end coordination, stakeholder alignment, and post-event performance review. Develop and scale VIP growth programs and tools (e.g., VIP trial cards and similar programs) that improve conversion, deepen engagement, and increase VIP contribution to trading activity and AUM. Establish a data-driven growth operating model with clear measurement, experimentation, and continuous optimization to improve VIP contribution to revenue and AUM. Coordinate with cross-functional teams (Product, Data, Engineering, Operations) to deliver workflows, tooling, and process improvements that support VIP operations at scale. Track performance and continuously optimize: define KPIs, monitor results, gather market feedback, and refine programs based on data and learnings. What We Look For In YouBachelor's degree or higher with 5 years of product management or product strategy experience. Deep understanding of the Web3/Crypto industry, particularly exchange products such as institutional services, API trading, and VIP incentive programs. Prior experience in CEXs, brokerages, financial institutions, or high-net-worth client-related products is preferred. Strong cross-team communication and coordination skills, with systematic thinking and sharp user insights. Proficiency in data analysis tools and data-driven decision-making. Fluency in English and Chinese; Multi-market collaboration experience is a plus. L\&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development Various team building programs and company events Wellness and meal allowances Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants More that we love to tell you along the process! #J-18808-Ljbffr
